## Description

Brief summary of what this PR does and why.

## Related Issues

Closes #, Fixes #, or References #

## Type of Change

- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change that fixes an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change that adds functionality)
- [ ] Breaking change (fix or feature that would cause existing functionality to not work as expected)
- [ ] Documentation update
- [ ] Code quality (refactoring, tests, CI, tooling)

## Checklist

- [ ] My code follows the project's coding standards (PHP CS Fixer, Rector, PHPStan)
- [ ] I have run `ddev code-check` and it passes
- [ ] I have run `ddev test` and all tests pass
- [ ] I have added tests that prove my fix is effective or that my feature works
- [ ] I have updated documentation if needed (`docs/`, `AGENTS.md`, `README.md`)
- [ ] I have tested this with `ddev start` and verified it works in the browser
- [ ] I have run `ddev build` and verified static site builds without errors

## Screenshots / Output

If applicable, add screenshots, terminal output, or before/after comparisons.
